claims.statement: For n=77, let rho(x,y)=(y,76-x) and define the rct4 subclass to consist exactly of subsets S of G_77 whose anti-diagonal is empty, whose occupied cells off both diagonals are unions of complete four-cell rho-orbits, and whose main-diagonal intersection is exactly one antipodal rho-squared pair. The Boolean constraint system constructed by verify_rct4_instance.py is sound and complete for the 154-point no-three-in-line members of this explicitly defined subclass: selecting exactly 38 of its 1,444 off-diagonal orbit variables and exactly one of its 38 diagonal-pair variables expands to 154 points, and the expansion is no-three-in-line if and only if it satisfies all 388,148 canonical deduplicated weighted maximal-line constraints. The canonical constraint serialization has digest sha256:5c0051739717f52f8eddd00cd01e8a83030849b3fd7b4516b0d308882c9aaf62. This claim does not assert satisfiability or infeasibility, does not cover general half-turn, reflection-symmetric, or asymmetric configurations, does not classify all rotations, and does not change the bounds on D(77).
